name: C++
description: C++17 and CMake, with raven.hpp: lambdas for callbacks, a class per kind of widget.
run_windows: cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build --config Release && build\Release\{{PROJECT_IDENT}}.exe
readme:
cmake -S . -B build
    cmake --build build --config Release

then run the program from this folder (`build/{{PROJECT_IDENT}}`, or `build\Release\{{PROJECT_IDENT}}.exe` with Visual Studio). `raven.hpp` is the C++ layer of Raven, copied from the SDK.
